event.description: Retry the fixed-basis rank-8 positional-code model with 45000 training steps and a 10%-of-base learning-rate floor after its 92.55% late-stage validation trajectory under zero-ending cosine decay.
event.proposal: Family: training control. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted training-control candidate; the most recent failed training-control result was attempt-0011, a 45000-step learning-rate-floor retry for the distinct no-offset normalization model that was an optimization failure; 1 prior attempt in this family. The immediately preceding fixed-position-basis attempt-0017 is an optimization failure, not a scored nonqualification: its 3318-parameter model reached 92.55% validation at step 30000 and was still climbing as its cosine learning rate reached zero. This is an explicitly changed-condition retry, not a silent retry: the architecture remains the same 3318-parameter learned rank-8 code plus fixed DCT expansion, but training changes to 45000 steps with a 10%-of-base tail to test whether premature annealing caused the observed late-stage ceiling. It is a training-control intervention, not parameterization-preserving compression. It is more informative than the nearest untested projection basis because it first distinguishes optimization duration from the representational effect that produced the continuous late improvement.
